A '''Wistie''' was part of a group owned by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and transported to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, the [[Wistie/Legends|Wistie]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] was released into a garden to serve as illumination. The Wistie and the others of her kind joined up with a group of [[Ghostling]]s that were hiding from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. This Wistie served as a lookout for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] or other thugs that were pursuing the escaped [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].
